note: Every pipeline that feeds the AI Intelligence Graph, with its cadence, cost class and what it writes. run_pipelines.py runs what is due, logs each run to ontology.pipeline_run, and never runs a paid pipeline unless the run is approved (--approve-paid with a cap). Cadence is hours.
